'''Smuggler's Delight''' was a sickly sweet pastry favored by many [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]]. It had a hollow center.<ref name="swg">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=item|Smuggler's Delight}}</ref> Eating it helped counteract the detrimental effects of [[Giggledust]]. [[Dash Rendar/Legends|Dash Rendar]] was particularly fond of that pastry.
